correctness.rationale: The weighted area and circle quadratic forms are simultaneously diagonal in harmonic Fourier modes. Their diagonal entries are exact beta integrals and powers of r, so the optimal constant is their largest ratio. The consecutive-ratio formula is monotone across one crossing and gives the unique maximizing degree or the unique adjacent two-degree tie. Equality spaces, source-normalization conversion, strict fixed-radius improvement, and the small-radius asymptotic all follow exactly.
